placements.why: The content establishes an organizational category for release governance — deployment gates, signed manifest requirements, and scope boundaries are organizational process decisions that future envelopes about release policies would nest under.
placements.title: Release governance as organizational discipline
placements.theme: Organizational gates on release and deployment processes ensure artifact integrity before code reaches production environments.

placements.title: Signed manifests gate Meridian deployments
placements.theme: Meridian deployments require signed release manifests across staging and production to prevent unsigned artifacts from shipping.
placements.why: src-1 declares the signed manifest requirement, src-2 provides the motivating incident (unsigned artifacts reaching staging), src-3 restates the gate requirement, and src-4 defines the scope (staging and production). Together they support a thematic leaf about signed manifest gating as a deployment control for Meridian.
